items.title: 68089_John Malachi oral history interview
items.q: She said, "Hi, John. Billy's in Chicago."

ctx.x: we were supposed to have that was supposed to pay me more money. Well, had a week off. So I came home. And the day that he was supposed to send me a plane ticket, and I was supposed to take the plane from Washington and meet him in Chicago... So when the date came a few days or a week or so later, when we were supposed to play there, I had heard nothing from Billy Eckstine.

So finally, I think the day before the engagement, I called Billy's house... And then he was married to June Eckstine. And I asked her for Billy. She said, "Hi, John. Billy's in Chicago." I said, "What?" She said, "Yeah. He left yesterday" or something. So I said, "I don't know what happened. He was supposed to send me a ticket." Anyway, I was very disappointed.

A week later, Billy called me to tell me about an engagement that we had in Seattle, I believe it was, and everything was going to be great. He mentioned something about the fact that when the thing happened in Chicago... He had some sort of a long story that he told me, which didn't sound like anything to me, because I think even if that did happen, he should have called me and told me about it. Nevertheless, I told him that I just didn't care to go that far speculating on making money, when I couldn't make it…
